# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_DIVERGENCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price opens outside the opening range with sustained VWAP deviation and a bullish ribbon alignment, mean-reversion to VWAP offers an edge. This occurs because intraday price tends to revert to VWAP after an extreme opening, especially when supported by a bullish ribbon (EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55) indicating underlying upward momentum.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: Define opening range (first 30 min) high-low as ORB. At 10:00 EST, if price > ORB high + 0.2*ATR(5) and VWAP (intraday) is below price by >0.15*ATR(5) and ribbon (EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55) is bullish, enter long at the close of that bar. Exit shape: chart-stop at ORB low (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail 20% off HWM using a chandelier trail. Regime hint: VIX < 18, time between 09:45-11:30, avoid FOMC windows.
